claim.statement: M.63 EMPIRICALLY VALIDATES M.52's architectural claim of three parallel independent inquiry systems under the native substrate. Across 100 Shakespeare paragraphs (post-BGE→native migration + full calibration), 22 statistical tests were run across all three pairwise comparisons: Walker × Zetetic (5 tests), Walker × Reflective Cortex (12 tests), Zetetic × Reflective Cortex (5 tests). Bonferroni α=0.05/22=0.00227. Surviving signals: 0 total; 0 for Walker × Reflective, 0 for Zetetic × Reflective. Reflective Cortex operates on its own cadence — uncorrelated with both Walker halt-mode and Zetetic firing intensity. Combined with M.62 (Walker × Zetetic cognitive convergence does NOT replicate under native), the three-way L3 architectural independence is now empirically established post-calibration.
claim.operationalization: 100 stride-sampled paragraphs from pg100.txt run through fresh Takwin (native substrate + calibrated profile). Per cycle: capture resolution, n_zetetic_contradictions, walk_length, phi, and reflective snapshot (reflection_type, n_recent_metabolic_events, energy_reserve, delta_paradoxes, delta_fused, delta_annihilated, delta_absorbed). Per-pair zetetic rate computed as raw count divided by C(walk_length, 2). Pairwise tests: Mann-Whitney U on signals by halt mode + Spearman rank correlations. Joint Bonferroni across all 22 tests.
claim.h0: Reflective Cortex correlates with Walker or Zetetic under native substrate
claim.h1: All three inquiry systems are statistically independent under native substrate

preregistration.analysis_plan: Three pairwise independence tests under native: Walker × Zetetic (5 tests), Walker × Reflective (12 tests), Zetetic × Reflective (5 tests). Joint Bonferroni across all 22.

detail.interpretation: all p-values well above 0.05 (no borderline cases)

detail.note: delta_paradoxes and delta_fused both 0 across all cycles (substrate didn't fire those events) — limits power of those specific tests, but events + energy signals are well-distributed

verdict.reasoning: Walker × Reflective: 12 tests, raw p-values range 0.62-1.00 (no signal anywhere near 0.05). Zetetic × Reflective: 5 tests, raw p-values range 0.44-0.74 (no signal). Walker × Zetetic (replicating M.62): weak residual signals (Spearman zetetic-walk rho=-0.279 p=0.0047, zetetic-phi rho=+0.266 p=0.0073) — none survive joint Bonferroni correction with the larger test set. The Reflective Cortex independence is robust (raw p-values strongly non-significant), not borderline. Energy reserve mean=964, n_recent_metabolic_events median=10 — meaningful signal range observed, just uncorrelated with the other two systems.
